# Claude Code plan-preview — extracted assets

Snapshot of the styling used by the Claude Code VS Code extension when
it renders a plan in its `claudePlanPreview` webview.

**Source :** `anthropic.claude-code-2.1.145` — `extension.js`, inline
`<style>` block of the webview template (var `NK0`). Verified byte-for-byte.

## HTML is generated by `marked`

The extension bundles the [`marked`](https://github.com/markedjs/marked)
markdown parser (minified alias `$4` — signature confirmed by
`$4.Renderer`, `$4.Lexer`, `$4.Tokenizer`, `$4.walkTokens`,
`$4.parseInline`, `$4.use`, `$4.setOptions`). Rendering is a plain
`$4.parse(markdown)` with the default options — no custom renderer, no
Anthropic-specific tokenization. To reproduce the same HTML output
outside the extension :

```bash
npm i marked
```

```js
import { marked } from "marked";
document.body.innerHTML = marked.parse(yourMarkdown);
```

## The CSS is 100 % Anthropic-custom

`marked` ships zero styling — the look-and-feel comes entirely from
[`plan-viewer.css`](./plan-viewer.css) in this directory. All colors,
fonts, borders and paddings are declared via VS Code theme CSS
variables so the panel automatically follows the active theme :

- `--vscode-editor-foreground` / `--vscode-editor-background`
- `--vscode-markdown-font-family` / `--vscode-markdown-font-size`
- `--vscode-editor-font-family` / `--vscode-editor-font-size`
- `--vscode-textCodeBlock-background`
- `--vscode-textLink-foreground` / `--vscode-textLink-activeForeground`
- `--vscode-panel-border`
- `--vscode-textBlockQuote-border` / `--vscode-textBlockQuote-foreground`
- `--vscode-editor-findMatchHighlightBackground`
- `--vscode-editorWidget-background` / `--vscode-editorWidget-border`
- `--vscode-button-background` / `--vscode-button-foreground` / `--vscode-button-hoverBackground`
- `--vscode-button-secondaryBackground` / `--vscode-button-secondaryForeground` / `--vscode-button-secondaryHoverBackground`
- `--vscode-input-background` / `--vscode-input-foreground` / `--vscode-input-border`
- `--vscode-descriptionForeground`
- `--vscode-focusBorder`
- `--vscode-font-family` / `--vscode-font-size`

The CSS covers the markdown output (headings, paragraphs, code, pre,
blockquote, lists, tables, hr, links) **and** a custom commenting UI
(`mark` with `color-mix`, `.comment-indicator`, `#comment-btn`,
`#comment-input`, `#comment-banner`, `.comment-actions`).

## Webview messaging protocol

Parent → webview :

- `{type: "updateContent", html}` — inject new markdown-rendered HTML
- `{type: "setCommentsEnabled", enabled}` — toggle comment UI availability
- `{type: "removeComment", commentId}` — drop a comment marker

Webview → parent :

- `{type: "ready"}` — sent once the webview script has booted
- `{type: "comment", id, selectedText, sectionHeading, comment}` —
  emitted when the user submits a comment on a selection
